frozen_evaluation_frame.roi: initial selected G0 axis-aligned bounding box inflated by 0.10 m on every side, intersected with scene evaluation bounds
frozen_evaluation_frame.gap_component: G0 is the detector connected initial unknown-voxel component after reachability and wall filtering

gap_reduction.unknown_count: U_t = count(v in G0 where TSDF_weight_t(v) = 0)
gap_reduction.raw_formula: R = 0 if U_0 = 0 or episode fails; otherwise R = 1 - U_after / U_0
gap_reduction.reporting: retain raw R; clip only reported R to [0, 1]

surface_distance.gt_sampling: exactly 10000 deterministic area-stratified mesh surface samples from (scene_manifest, episode_seed), transformed by frozen T_map_world
surface_distance.reconstruction_surface: zero-crossing vertices within ROI with TSDF weight > 0
surface_distance.failure_rule: missing surface, terminal failure, NaN, or unexplained output sets all 10000 distances to +inf
surface_distance.quantization: finite distances round to nearest 0.001 m, ties to even, before statistics

eew_ped.formula: concatenate exactly 10000 quantized post distances from every scheduled episode, including +inf; apply numpy.percentile(method='higher')

scoring.operational_episode_success: normal COMPLETE within budgets AND at least one authorized wrist window fused AND U_after < U_0 AND all required metrics finite AND zero forbidden collisions
scoring.cohort_success: successful scheduled episodes / scheduled episodes; no silent rerun
scoring.prestart_infrastructure_retry: declared pre-start infrastructure failure may rerun once; retain both records and fix scheduled adjudication before execution
scoring.macro_aggregation: gap, completeness, and completeness improvement are macro-means over scheduled episodes with failures scored as zero
scoring.collision: any forbidden collision fails the episode and the absolute zero-collision stage gate

pairing.go2_only: identical scene, noise, and navigation trace until arm handoff
pairing.stage4: concatenate each lane quantized 10000-distance arrays over the same manifest; integrated minus Go2-only P50 <= 0 and P95 <= 0; ties pass; missing or NaN fails
